technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (PPO crossover, volume spike, TEMA cross) show bullish intent, but price remains below key 50-period moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating structural headwinds for a swing entry.

fundamental.summary: QCOM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 90 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite congressional selling by senior senators 100+ days ago; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (416.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 90 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum signals (PPO crossover, 15x volume spike, TEMA cross) with extreme fear sentiment (21/100) create a contrarian buy setup near support at 119.65, offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Structural bearishness (price below 50-SMA and 200-EMA, below Ichimoku cloud) combined with crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro environment, high earnings risk in 90 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-probability pullback trap rather than a swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (PPO crossover, 15x volume spike) and extreme fear sentiment (21/100) create a contrarian setup, but structural bearishness (price below 50-SMA, 200-EMA, Ichimoku cloud) combined with crisis-level macro conditions makes this a low-probability swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (416.64) and unfavorable macro environment (rising USD, flat yield curve) create binary downside risk that overwhelms short-term momentum signals; earnings in 90 days adds uncompensated event risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical shows moderate entry quality but all other agents (fundamental, risk, debate) align on bearish structural setup and macro headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already 12 positions in Information Technology sector; adding QCOM increases concentration risk without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify it.
